execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "organization_read_60a464d6" ON "public"."organizations" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO PUBLIC USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_invitations i WHERE i.organization_id = organizations.id AND i.recipient_email = current_setting('vops.email', true) AND i.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.expires_at > now()) OR (current_setting('vops.public_workspaces', true) = 'true' AND recruitment_open AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND enrollment_ready) OR (current_setting('vops.platform', true) = 'true' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.platform_grants g WHERE g.user_id = nullif(current_setting('vops.user_id', true), '')::integer AND g.active AND g.role = 'TECH_ADMIN')) OR id = nullif(current_setting('vops.organization_id', true), '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = organizations.id AND m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('vops.user_id', true), '')::integer))
